description:
Make CI run the suite with the same runner as `cargo-ci`.

## Background

`.github/workflows/ci.yml:139-143` installs the pinned nextest and validates its config, then `:158` runs `cargo test --workspace` and `:161-163` runs `cargo test --test '*'` in `crates/jit`, which appears to repeat the integration tests the first step ran. `scripts/cargo-ci.sh` runs nextest, so CI and the gate use different runners, and failures can reach one and not the other. The feature- and test-specific runs at `:285` and `:316` may stay.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: CI's test step uses the same pinned nextest invocation as `scripts/cargo-ci.sh`, from one definition.
- [hard] REQ-02: The duplicate step is gone, or this issue names what it adds that the first lacks.
title: CI runs the suite with the same runner as the gate
